snippet.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The free playable demo of DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World allows you to experience the game from the start of the story up to the conclusion of events in Witherwood as you get to grips with recruiting, raising, and synthesizing monsters. For playing the demo, you can receive an item set for use in the full game. And, if you keep your save data from the demo, you'll be able to transfer up to 8 monsters from your main party and reserves into the full game.

*Only monsters of rank G and rank F can be befriended in the demo.
*Bonus content cannot be claimed in the demo.

Bonuses for Playing the Demo
- Wrangler's Bundle
    ・Ring of Impulse x1
    ・Bonus Ball x1
    ・Smoked Sirloin x5

Demo Available on: Nintendo Switch™ 2, Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®5, XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC and Steam®.
